strings.en: We really owe the Gandor Team for coming to our aid, Captain.
Thanks to them, my Akito is safe too!
Not at all. I'm just glad we made it in time.
Besides, the Admiral was very worried about you.
That's what they call a doting parent, right?
But if the Gandor Team hadn't come, we would've been finished.
What on earth did that enemy want there...?
They must have had some purpose.
Allow me to explain!
Whoa, a surprise entrance by the Explainin' Auntie, Inez Fressange!
Yo! We've been waiting!
The "Auntie" part... is uncalled for.
So, Inez?
Ahem. The Nanafushi was releasing a great deal of energy
to charge its micro black hole shells...
That enemy mistook the energy reading for "something" else...
and appeared at Kursk, I presume...
Mistook it for something else?
Mutron.
Mutron!? The stuff they say powers Raideen?
The thing Akira's dad is researching!?
"Mutron," the super energy of ancient Mu.
An unknown energy that our current science can't explain.
That enemy may know Mutron's true value...
Mutron is certainly full of mysteries... but would aliens
know its value?
What if the energy we call Mutron also exists out in space?
Does it?
I don't know... it's only my guess...
But if so, wouldn't that explain a lot of things?
Hmm. It's no surprise some force would target a precious energy, but...
is this Mutron really that remarkable...?
By the way, Captain, have you reported to Admiral Misumaru yet?
Oh nooo! I have to tell Father the operation's over...
Ho ho... What a rare mobile suit I've come by this time.
Benmel... Commander Benmel...
Lady Koros!?
Benmel... Collecting is fine... but is the operation progressing?
O-Of course, Lady Koros...
As you see, today I seized an Earth transport plane for my collec... er,
I was just selecting personnel to turn into Meganoids.
...Then all is well... The Don is concerned as well...
H-Hail, Don Zauser.
Ohh, you're safe, Yurikaaa! I was so worried!
I'm sorry to have worried you, Father.
By the time we arrived at Kursk, the Nanafushi
had already been silenced by the Aestivalis team's attack.
I see. So I sent you and your team on a wasted trip, Hazuki...
No, if the Gandor Team hadn't come,
the Nadesico might have been destroyed by the Gyandlar.
So even the Gyandlar showed up?
Father, what should the Nadesico do next?
Normally, I'd want you to stop Zeon's Operation Stardust
by joining up with Londo Bell, but that's not possible.
Amid all this chaos, several Tulips that couldn't be stopped in space
have been falling to the surface...
So eliminating those Tulips is the Nadesico's immediate goal.
Yes. I want the Gandor Team to keep giving its all to eliminate
enemy forces on the surface, like the Hyakki Empire and Campbell army.
Retaking Jaburo comes after that.
Understood.
Did you get through?
It's no good... Minovsky density and EM interference are too heavy...
I can't even pinpoint the ship's position.
Londo Bell, Commander Hazuki?
Yes... We can't reach them at all.
Commander, what about the Combattler Team...?
A new volcanic island in the Pacific... That seems to be their base.
I've told them to stand by in the skies above it... but...
Knowing them, they probably won't be able to hold back.
Of course. With the enemy base right in front of us, I'd charge right in.
Combattler Team aside, I am worried about the situation in space.
A derelict colony falling... We can't exactly hold it up from below.
Hey, Show. I asked before, but... what's a colony?
Everyone's making a fuss... but I don't know either.
Yeah, later, Cham.
Geez! You said that last time too!
It's complicated, okay!?
Fine, then I'll ask Todd!
Shut up, shrimp.
Hey! I didn't even ask yet! Bleh! You droopy-eyed jerk!
Listen, shorty, a colony is... hmm, kind of like a giant house.
A house? People live in it?
That's right. A whole lot of 'em, though.
I get it! A giant mansion is gonna fall down!
Thanks for trying, Mister Jinguji. Cham, you see...
This is why I didn't want to explain it.
...It won't come crashing down on our heads mid-battle... will it?
If someone meddles with the colony halfway... it could happen.
No use scaring each other. Right, let's go help the Combattler Team...
This is the Saotome Laboratory! Gandor Team!
Commander Hazuki, please respond! This is the Saotome Laboratory!
From the Doc!?
Opening the channel!
Dr. Saotome, what's the matter?
Oh, Commander Hazuki! You're still alive!
Doc! Don't say stuff like that, it's bad luck!
So, what happened?
Don't tell me... Getter Robo G is finished...!
Getter Robo... G!? You mean Getter Robo's getting even stronger?
Reassuring. ...I'd like my machine powered up too, but...
Ryo, you're half right.
But the other half... the Hyakki Empire is closing in on the Saotome Lab...!
Huh? The Nadesico's leaving?
Apparently they have a separate operation from ours...
Really? And here I thought we were getting stronger...
There are lots of enemies on the surface and in space.
We have to split up for now, or we won't be able to handle them all.
Space, huh... I wonder if Princess Romina's okay...
Big Bro, what's up? Thinking hard doesn't suit you, y'know.
Weren't you thinking about Princess Romina?
I-It's not like that!
That's an easy reaction to read, Joe.
Huh, so you go for the girl who's a princess through and through.
I'd say she's just naive about the world.
You peanut gallery, butt out!
What's wrong with me worrying about the guys who went to space?
The guys? Don't you mean one person in particular?
What, Lenny? You're really picking a fight today!
No reason~
...She's... easy to read, too.
Yeah...
If you've got time for dumb arguments, go tune up your machines.
Tetsuya's as dense as ever, too...
What on earth are you talking about?
It's something you wouldn't get, Domon.
Pilots in the briefing room! Come up to the bridge at once!
I repeat, all pilots assemble on the bridge.
That's from the bridge. Did something happen?
Is it about the Combattler Team? I heard they found the enemy base...
I've got a bad feeling about this, though.
From the sound of it... something's happened.
No doubt about it. Honestly...
...And that is the situation.
Mars Frontier Base Commander Hazard is linked to the Meganoids.
Then the one who helped the Meganoids revive really was...
Indeed. We may safely assume it was Mr. Hazard.
In the last war, the Meganoid leaders, Don Zauser and Koros,
were never confirmed destroyed.
If they were hiding... it could only be at the Mars Frontier Base.
See, Commander Hazuki? That bastard Hazard was in on it after all!
Wait, who's this old guy?
I have the honor of serving as Master Banjo's butler.
My name is Garrison Tokita. And you must be Joe Maya.
Master Banjo has instructed me to be of help to the Gandor Team.
Should you need anything, please just ask.
Anything else, Garrison?
The missing Crocus has apparently been found at the Martian polar cap.
The Crocus? Oh, the battleship that got sucked into a Tulip.
Commander Hazuki, have you heard anything about it
from Mr. Hazard at the development base?
No, nothing to me, and it seems nothing to the Admiral either.
Hazard Pasha must be keeping watch on the Tulips too.
There's no way he hasn't noticed...
It seems safe to say something is going on behind the scenes.
Was the Crocus crew all right?
Regrettably, I'm told they were all dead.
All dead...? What happened?
According to the information we obtained, the Crocus crew
was found in a gruesome state, neither quite organic nor inorganic.
No... That's horrible...
Not a sight I want to imagine.
What caused it?
It's said the cause was probably being sucked into a Tulip,
and then making a Boson Jump.
The cause was warping through a Tulip...?
Huh? Wait a minute.
Didn't that ship, the Nadesico or whatever, jump here too?
The Nadesico has a Distortion Field. Isn't that what saved it?
The details are unknown.
Well, no use saying "we don't know" over and over.
That's not what we came here to talk about, right?
Exactly. The reason I've gathered you all here is none other than this:
we must discuss where we head next.
Sorry, we're late.
Excuse me...
You're late, Lieutenant Amada!
Whoo-hoo!
Cham? What's gotten into you?
Well, y'know, Shiro was being all like you and Marvel...
Shiro... That's why I said we should close the door properly...
...Not being on a battlefield is no reason to let your guard down.
Ahem! Here's the briefing. There are two points we must head for.
...Either we hit the Campbellians' base, or we go to the Saotome Lab first.
Shouldn't we go to the Saotome Laboratory first?
But distance-wise, the Combattler team is closer.
True. We could join up with Combattler V,
then turn right around and take on the Hyakki Empire...
Dr. Saotome was confident the lab wouldn't fall that easily, after all.
But I can't say whether we can rely on those words.
Or we recover Getter Robo G first, then deal with the Campbellians.
I have the Combattler team on standby.
I'd rather take the latter. I'm worried about the lab.
But Ryo, what if the Hyakki guys turn out to be crazy tough?
Going in without the Combattler team is a big hit to our strength, y'know?
True. Either way, we have to choose one or the other...
I'll leave it to you.
Might I suggest the following?
I shall compile every bit of information I can in a few minutes.
The Hyakki Empire's movements, the size of the Campbellian force...
There is a great deal of information to be had, you see.
I'd like to go to the lab myself, but...
Tokita, please start gathering information for now.
Very good, sir. I shall return to the terminal room, then.
What a dependable old gentleman.
Seriously. Okay, guess I'll go check on Blast Dragon...
Oh, I almost forgot.
Just now... I hear Za Boom combat robots may be heading for Kyoto.
What!?
So we've got yet another option!
You FORGOT!? Ugh! I take back what I said!
